new_jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, PCB, AWS Server Supply Chain
new_jobs.jd: **Description** AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Services & Supply Chain (AIS-SC) organization works to deliver leading-edge solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth! Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a highly effective candidate to identify, create, develop and integrate innovative technology to deliver the best operating, lowest cost infrastructure in the world. This individual will lead the manufacturing operations of PCB (Printed Circuits Boards) needed for Printed Circuit Board Assemblies that meet our customers' rapidly growing infrastructure needs. Successful candidates will bring strong knowledge of PCB manufacturing process, PCB supply chains, PCB manufacturing operations, quality assurance operations, and provide oversight of outsourced manufacturing teams. AWS serves over a million active customers in more than 190 countries. We are steadily expanding global infrastructure to help our customers achieve lower latency and higher throughput. As our customers grow their businesses, AWS will continue to provide infrastructure that meets their global requirements. Key job responsibilities * Develop and implement Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Process & Systems Optimization for AWS hardware infrastructure. * Continuous Improvement: Lead Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma initiatives to shorten cycle times and improve overall yield. * System Audits: Conduct regular audits of manufacturing systems and technical infrastructure to ensure high-performance standards. * Understand PCB industry and technology trends. * Identify key technology trends in the PCB industry and drive supplier product roadmaps and execute on strategic initiatives in those products. * Responsible to provide weekly team updates, deliver executive level updates on a monthly basis, and will be responsible for vendor escalations in order to resolve any issues related to his/her category. * Present to senior leadership via written narratives. **About The Team** Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. **Professional Traits That Are Necessary For Amazon Leaders** * Exhibits excellent judgment * Has high standards (is never satisfied with the status quo) * Is able to dive deep and is never out of touch with the details of the business * Expects and requires innovation of her/his team * Has passion and convictions and the innate ability to inspire passion in others * Strong results orientation * Thinks big **Basic Qualifications** * 6+ years of professional or military experience * Bachelor's degree **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations * Experience working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT. * 6+ years of responding to requests for proposals (e.g., determining requirements, matching requirements to technical approach and solutions, developing solutions against requirements) experience * 6+ years of experience in Server Industry development and/or manufacturing Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. **Company** - Amazon Data Services Taiwan Limited Job ID: A10457794

new_jobs.title: Product Management Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Job Summary** Supplier professional focused on the strategic leadership and relationship of company suppliers to achieve the best financial performance and relationship with assigned product lines **Principal Responsibilities** * Directs and manages the supplier business plan and implementation process throughout the organization leveraging supplier strengths and resources on behalf of the supplier and communicating supplier benefits to the company. * Aligns goals and objectives of supplier with the company to ensure mutual goals and objectives are achieved. * Determines, monitors and recommends plans for the supplier, company business relationship on a tactical and strategic level. * Participates in supplier business reviews providing appropriate data and engaging in resolving issues. * Identifies and drives new supplier opportunities with particular emphasis on the development of new services that blend unique supplier resource/capability along with service/capability to create a unique value proposition. * Supports cross functional communication with the company's product groups in price negotiations and market knowledge. * Responsible for the management of activities and programs that will drive the supplier’s pro-forma performance in an effort to achieve Avnet's financial goals. * Performs analysis and reports of various program impact for the supplier. * Manages forecasting pipeline requirements and rebate projections. * Other duties as assigned. **Job Level Specifications** * Mastery knowledge of industry best practices and disciplines. Considered a subject matter expert within the organization and contributes to the development of new concepts, techniques and standards. * Develops solutions to highly complex and uniquely challenging situations. Assignments require extensive evaluation of alternatives and variables. Expected to make improvements to policies and procedures. * Works independently toward long-range goals and objectives. Assignments are often self-initiated using independent judgment and discretion. May act as informal team lead and/or coach less experienced team members. * Serves as consultant to management and/or internal/external spokesperson for the organization on major initiatives related to policies, plans and long-range objectives. * Actions may impact the organization and its reputation. Effects of erroneous decisions may be long-lasting, influence the future course of the organization and/or require the expenditure of extensive additional resources. **Work Experience** * Typically 8+ years with bachelor's or equivalent. **Education And Certification(s)** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained. **Distinguishing Characteristics** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer (Python)
new_jobs.jd: Our client is looking for a backend engineer to take full ownership of core features on their medical imaging platform. This isn't a role where you hand off your code at the pull request - you’ll be directly responsible for system correctness, production stability, and the integrity of clinical data that directly impacts patient care. The data science team builds the machine learning models; your job is to build the robust, deterministic platform that powers them. You’ll spend your time designing scalable architectures, untangling concurrency edge cases, ensuring zero-downtime data migrations, and keeping legacy services stable while building their replacements. **What you will do:** * Core Backend Architecture: Drive the technical direction of our Python/FastAPI ecosystem, from API design to background task distribution and production observability * Data Integrity & Persistence: Architect and evolve our PostgreSQL schemas. You’ll manage migrations, lock mechanisms, query tuning, and multi-tenant data isolation under strict HIPAA/PHI compliance * Resilient Image Processing Pipelines: Design asynchronous, event-driven pipelines handling heavy medical imaging files—from ingest and de-identification to model inference and result delivery * Cross-Functional System Contracts: Define clean, reliable API interfaces with frontend teams and establish clear model input/output contracts with data scientists * Technical Records & Legacy Transition: Maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), run thorough design reviews, and reliably maintain our legacy TypeScript service through its planned sunset **What you will need:** * Deep Systems & Backend Fundamentals: 5+ years of software engineering experience with proven production ownership. While our current stack is Python and FastAPI, we care more about deep systems fundamentals (Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, or TypeScript) than language familiarity * Concurrency & Distributed Systems Expertise: Strong intuition for race conditions, deadlocks, idempotent processing, and "at least once" messaging failure modes * Database & Messaging Mastery: Production experience with PostgreSQL internals (indexing, transactions, row-level locks) and message brokers (queues, dead-letter strategies, exponential backoffs) * Engineering Rigor: Commitment to typed code, automated testing suites, automated pipelines (CI/CD, Docker), and efficient leverage of modern AI developer tooling * Autonomy & Communication: Ability to challenge requirements before writing code, set technical standards, and collaborate fluently in both English and Chinese **Nice-to-haves:** * GCP Infrastructure: Experience operating containerized workloads on Google Cloud Platform * Healthtech & DICOM: Direct experience with medical imaging workflows, DICOM standard protocols, or healthcare regulatory frameworks * Isolation Mechanics: Multi-tenant database patterns (e.g., Row-Level Security) or experience deploying hybrid cloud/on-prem solutions * Scientific Computing Context: Exposure to NumPy, computational geometry, or light frontend familiarity (React/TypeScript) We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Spclst, Business Insights & Analytics
new_jobs.jd: **THE OPPORTUNITY** The **Senior Specialist, Business Insights & Analytics** (BIA) is a strategic analytics partner supporting commercial, marketing, and omnichannel decision-making across priority therapeutic areas. This role transforms complex internal and external data into **clear, actionable insights** that shape brand strategy, customer engagement, sales effectiveness, and business performance. Acting as a **data translator** , the Senior Specialist BIA bridges business needs with analytics, data science, market research, and technology teams. The role contributes actively to a **data-driven culture** , ensures alignment with global analytics frameworks, and may mentor junior analysts while collaborating within the international BIA community. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** **1. Business & Commercial Insights** * Analyze current and historical performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and risks across brands, campaigns, customers, and channels. * Provide fact-based recommendations to support **marketing strategy, sales execution, forecasting, and omnichannel effectiveness** . * Translate complex analytics into clear narratives tailored to senior and nontechnical stakeholders. * Deliver ad-hoc analyses to support strategic and operational decision making. **2. Performance Measurement & Reporting** * Contribute to the design of **dashboards and standard reports** tracking KPIs related to brand performance, sales force effectiveness, and customer engagement. * Ensure consistency, equity, and robustness of KPIs across therapeutic areas and functions. * Monitor campaign, brand, and omnichannel performance, highlighting insights and opportunities. * Continuously improve reporting processes in collaboration with IT, global teams, and external partners. **3. Advanced Analytics & Synthesis** * Leverage advanced analytics outputs (e.g. forecasting, segmentation, spend optimization) to enrich insights and recommendations. * Partner closely with Data Science teams to contribute to or interpret predictive models when relevant. * Support business planning and forecasting accuracy through analytical input and scenario analysis. * Identify and integrate **new data sources** such as primary or secondary Market Research. * Partner with IT, Data Stewards, and external providers to ensure **data quality, integrity, and governance** . * Support compliant data usage in line with local and global policies (e.g. GDPR, market research standards). **4. AI-Enabled Productivity & Insights** * Embraces AI as a core capability and proactively identifies opportunities to apply AI solutions to business challenges and operational processes. * Champions the responsible adoption of AI, balancing innovation with governance, compliance, and ethical considerations. * Uses AI tools to augment analysis, decision-making, content development, and workflow execution, improving team productivity and business impact. * Contributes to and supports the design and implementation of AI-enabled solutions that deliver measurable value and accelerate business outcomes. **5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement** * Act as a trusted analytics partner to Marketing, Sales and DHH Capabilities Enablement teams. * Collaborate within the global BIA community to share best practices and ensure strategic alignment. * Contribute to data literacy initiatives and mentor junior analysts where applicable. **WHAT YOU MUST HAVE** * Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or related field * 5+ years in analytics or data analysis (regulated industry preferred) * Commercial, marketing, or sales support experience required; pharma/healthcare a plus * Advanced skills with Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI; Python/R knowledge is beneficial * Working knowledge of AI and Generative AI technologies, including responsible and compliant use within a business environment. * Experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, analysis, content development, and decision-making. * Ability to interpret complex data, deliver actionable insights, and communicate effectively * Strategic problem solver with strong business acumen and storytelling skills * Collaborative team player experienced across business and technical teams * Adaptable and willing to learn new tools and approaches * Professional English for global collaboration is required; fluency in local language is preferred
